minimum_basis: HireAHelper: labor-only movers often have a two-hour minimum, $160 to $300 for a team of two. U-Haul's Moving Help marketplace: the least a customer can reserve is 2 hours. $160 is the low end of that minimum (judgment call).
base: Package prices are for a studio or 1 bedroom with one flight of stairs or less at each end; the home size factor scales the load and unload jobs. The hourly rate is per mover, billed by the actual time with a 2 hour minimum.

packages.label: Load and unload job
includes: 2 movers at both ends of the move
Floors, door frames and railings protected
Unloaded and placed room by room
packages.basis: Studio or 1 bedroom, both ends: HireAHelper $296 to $362 labor only; Bellhop $200 to $500 for a studio; iMoving $300 to $800 for a studio or 1 bedroom. HireAHelper's estimating chart puts it at 2 movers for 4 hours, which at $40 to $80 per mover hour is $320 to $640. The range is a judgment call inside these.

sources.says: Labor-only movers cost $40 to $75 per mover per hour. Local labor-only cost by home size: 1BR or studio $296 to $362, 1,500 sq ft $446 to $545, 2,000 sq ft $450 to $550, 3,000 sq ft $540 to $660, 4BR+ $684 to $836.

Labor-only moving runs $40 to $80 per mover per hour, with a 2 to 4 hour minimum. Studio: 2 movers for 2 to 3 hours, $200 to $500. 1 to 2 bedrooms: 2 to 3 movers for 3 to 6 hours, $400 to $900. 3 or more bedrooms: 3 to 4 movers for 5 to 8 hours, $800 to $1,500 or more. Labor costs only, no transportation included.

Moving labor costs $60 to $100 per mover per hour with a 2 to 3 hour minimum. Studio or 1 bedroom: 2 movers for 2 to 4 hours, $300 to $800. 2 bedroom $720 to $1,500; 3 bedroom $1,200 to $2,800; 4 or more bedrooms $2,000 and up.

Estimating chart, load and unload: studio or small apartment 2 movers for 4 hours; 2 to 3 bedroom apartment 2 movers for 5 hours; 2 to 3 bedroom house 3 movers for 7 hours; 3 to 4 bedroom house 4 movers for 7 to 8 hours; 4 or more bedroom house 4 movers for 8 to 10 hours.

packages.label: Load or unload job
includes: 2 movers at one end: loading or unloading
Heavy, sturdy pieces first, packed tight in tiers
A rental truck, a container or a storage unit
packages.basis: Studio or 1 bedroom, one end: HireAHelper says a 2 person crew loads in 2 to 3 hours and unloads in 1 to 2; with the 2 hour minimum at $40 to $80 per mover hour that is $160 to $480. U-Haul Moving Help lists $208 to $402 for 2 movers for 2 hours. The 150 minutes is a judgment call between loading and unloading times.

sources.says: With a two-person crew: studio or 1 bedroom loads in 2 to 3 hours and unloads in 1 to 2; 2 bedroom 3 to 4 and 1.5 to 2.5; 3 bedroom 4 to 6 and 2.5 to 4; 4 or more bedrooms 6 to 8 and 3 to 5. Loading takes about 1.5 to 2 times longer than unloading.
Labor-only movers have a two-hour minimum, putting the starting cost at $160 to $300 for a team of two; $40 to $75 per mover per hour.
Moving Help prices based on two labor-only movers for two hours: loading and unloading $208 to $402; packing or unpacking $202 to $318; cleaning $193 to $308.

packages.label: Small job (2 movers, 2 hours)
includes: Furniture moved or rearranged in the home
A container, storage unit or small truck loaded
packages.basis: The 2 hour minimum for 2 movers: HireAHelper $160 to $300; Bellhop $200 to $400; U-Haul Moving Help $208 to $402.

sources.says: Most moving companies have minimums, often two movers for at least two hours; for labor-only movers that is $160 to $300 for a team of two.
Two movers for two hours run about $200 to $400; most labor-only movers have a 2 to 4 hour minimum.
Two labor-only movers for two hours: loading and unloading $208 to $402.

packages.label: Packing session (2 movers, 2 hours)
includes: 2 movers packing or unpacking for up to 2 hours
Fragile pieces wrapped, boxes labeled by room
Boxes and tape from the customer
packages.basis: U-Haul Moving Help: packing or unpacking with 2 movers for 2 hours, $202 to $318. HireAHelper's $40 to $75 per mover hour gives $160 to $300 for the same time; its paid packing for a whole home is $280 to $2,200.

sources.says: Two labor-only movers for two hours: professional packing or unpacking $202 to $318.
Labor-only movers cost $40 to $75 per mover per hour; paid packing costs between $280 and $2,200 depending on home size.

packages.label: Hourly rate, each mover
packages.basis: Labor only, per mover per hour: HireAHelper $40 to $75; Bellhop $40 to $80. iMoving ($60 to $100) and Fixr ($50 to $100) run higher: check current rates where you live. 30 minutes per mover hour assumes a crew of 2.
packages.note: Bellhop: peak season and weekends can add 10 to 30 percent.

sources.says: Labor-only movers cost $40 to $75 per mover per hour.
$40 to $80 per mover per hour for labor only; big-city rates and peak season or weekends can add 10 to 30 percent.
Moving labor costs $60 to $100 per mover per hour.
Loading and unloading help costs $50 to $100 per hour per mover.

factors.label: Home size
factors.basis: Judgment call: each size's price is the studio price times the mover hours in HireAHelper's estimating chart (2 movers for 4 hours = 8 for a studio; 10 for a 2 or 3 bedroom apartment; 21 for a 2 or 3 bedroom house; 30 for a 3 or 4 bedroom house; 36 for 4 or more bedrooms). HireAHelper's cost guide runs flatter and iMoving's steeper. Extra minutes are the chart's added hours for both ends.

sources.says: Load and unload: studio or small apartment 2 movers, 4 hours; 2 to 3 bedroom apartment 2 movers, 5 hours; 2 to 3 bedroom house 3 movers, 7 hours; 3 to 4 bedroom house 4 movers, 7 to 8 hours; 4 or more bedroom house 4 movers, 8 to 10 hours.
Studio or 1 bedroom $300 to $800; 2 bedroom $720 to $1,500; 3 bedroom $1,200 to $2,800; 4 or more bedrooms $2,000 and up.
Local labor-only cost: 1BR or studio $296 to $362; 3,000 sq ft $540 to $660; 4BR+ $684 to $836.

addons.label: Stairs, per flight after the first
addons.basis: Fixr: $50 to $100 per staircase after the first. moveBuddha groups stairs, elevators and long carries as destination fees of $75 to $500 or more. HireAHelper's estimating guide adds 30 to 60 minutes for each set of stairs.

sources.says: Stairs cost $50 to $100 per staircase after the first.
Destination fees for stairs, elevators, long carries or shuttle service at your new home: $75 to $500 or more.
Add 30 to 60 minutes (depending on the overall amount of furniture and boxes) for each set of stairs.

addons.label: Long carry, per extra 75 feet
addons.basis: Fixr: $75 to $125 per extra 75 feet when the truck can't park within about 150 feet of the door. moveBuddha: destination fees for long carries and stairs, $75 to $500 or more. The 20 minutes is a judgment call.

sources.says: A long carry fee of $75 to $125 per 75 extra feet applies when the truck can't park within about 150 feet of the home.
If the truck can't park near the home, expect extra charges for long carries, stairs, elevator use or shuttle services: $75 to $500 or more.

addons.label: Heavy item (upright piano, safe or pool table)
addons.basis: HireAHelper: heavy or awkward items like safes or pianos can carry a surcharge of $200 to $1,000. Liberty Safe: $175 to $525 to move a safe; U-Haul Moving Help: $363 on average for a gun safe; Thumbtack: piano $300 to $400, pool table $395 to $500. HireAHelper's estimating guide adds 30 minutes for pianos, pool tables and gun safes.
addons.note: Grand and baby grand pianos and hot tubs need special equipment: refer them to a specialist or quote them on their own.

sources.says: Heavy or awkward items, such as safes or pianos, can carry a surcharge of $200 to $1,000.
The standard pricing for moving a safe ranges from $175 to $525.
On average, it costs $363 to move a gun safe with Moving Help, at a flat rate.
Many moving companies charge an extra fee for heavy items such as pianos, safes or pool tables, especially over 300 pounds. Hot tub $350 to $450; piano $300 to $400; pool table $395 to $500.
Add 30 minutes for pianos, pool tables and gun safes; a baby grand piano needs special equipment.

plans_basis: No recurring plan: households move once in a while, so repeat work comes from referrals and partner businesses (judgment call).
